facts.fact: KRAY乘坐的巴士从印度瓦拉纳西开往尼泊尔加德满都，在连续十一个小时的爬升路程中走了很远才抛锚。
facts.anchor: it made it pretty far along its journey from Varanasi, India, to Kathmandu, Nepal, through eleven grinding hours of upward progress

facts.fact: 一名最多六岁、可能只有三英尺高的卖鸡蛋小女孩拦住KRAY，逼他买硬煮蛋。
facts.anchor: And she was tiny, six years old at most, and maybe three feet tall, if that.

facts.fact: 在路边等了三个小时后，KRAY启动B计划：从车后取包，沿路走五十米，伸出拇指示意搭车。
facts.anchor: After three hours of hanging around, though, he began to sense no quick fix was in the works. So he went to Plan B. Plan B was to retrieve his bag from the back of the bus, walk fifty meters down the road, and stick out his thumb.

facts.fact: 搭他的司机说自己上过艾奥瓦州的Luther College。
facts.anchor: I went to Luther College. It’s in Iowa.

facts.fact: 司机名叫Paras Bir Bikram Shah Dev，是尼泊尔前王储。
facts.anchor: Turns out the guy’s name was Paras Bir Bikram Shah Dev. And he was the former Crown Prince of Nepal.

facts.fact: Paras被Ricola润喉糖卡住气管、车冲向陡坡时，KRAY一手抓方向盘，另一手猛击他腹部，三下才把糖打出来。
facts.anchor: It took three hard jabs, but finally the lozenge flew out of Paras Shah’s mouth and onto the dashboard.

facts.fact: 两天后下午6点整，KRAY带着黄色文件夹到加德满都的Rum Doodle酒吧，与BUTTONFLY的加德满都联系人OVERFLOW接头。
facts.anchor: Two days later, KRAY showed up at Kathmandu’s famed Rum Doodle Bar with his yellow file folder at 6:00 p.m. sharp, as he had agreed with Barry Z. OVERFLOW, BUTTONFLY’s Kathmandu contact.

facts.fact: OVERFLOW说妻子七分钟前开始分娩，这是他们的第一个孩子。
facts.anchor: My wife went into labor seven minutes ago. Our first.
